---
title: "About this edition"
---

This is the free web edition of *The Bad Economics Handbook* by Jack Whitcomb. A print edition is also available.

**AI notice**

AI was not used in the writing of the textual content of the introduction, chapters, or appendix. Some citations, such as for licenses, were written by Claude Opus 5.5. Claude was also used to create and reproduce charts and other illustrations. Diffusion models, like Midjourney, were not used in the creation of any of this book's illustrations. Claude was also used for the sake of identifying some sources; in those cases, I have done my best to make sure the cited work has the claimed relevance to avoid problems caused by hallucinations. (Some sources are far too extensive for it to be practically reasonable to examine in entirety. For example, I cited a government report on bad lending practices when discussing the financial crisis. That report is hundreds of pages long and contains only two sentences considered relevant to the explanation being given.) I designed the cover in Paint.NET and had Claude clean it up a little; it decided to change the font choices.
